instrument_classification.rationale: The only concrete instruments named in the transcript are individual stocks (Apple, Tesla) and the anchor-selection rule refers to what moved the stock. The method is otherwise taught generically across markets and each instrument, and no specific tradable instrument, contract, or session is ever fixed.
instrument_classification.transcript_quote: When a hedge fund needs to buy 1 million shares of Apple, they can't just market buy it all at once.

strategies.name: VWAP Playbook: three-confirmation entry at VWAP with VWAP-band/volume-node stop and VWAP/volume-node targets
strategies.direction_transcript_quote: Above VWAP, look for shorts back to VWAP. Below VWAP, look for longs back to VWAP.
strategies.higher_timeframe_transcript_quote: Third, directional bias from higher time frame VWAP stack.

setup.description: Context / education (non-executable): what VWAP measures.
setup.transcript_quote: It shows the average price where real money actually changed hands throughout the day.

setup.description: Context / education (non-executable): the stated reason the level matters is that institutional algorithms use VWAP as their execution benchmark.
setup.transcript_quote: Instead, they use VWAP as their execution benchmark.

setup.description: Context: the transcript states there are three VWAP types that matter.
setup.transcript_quote: There are three VWAP types that actually matter.

setup.description: Context: daily VWAP resets every session and shows intraday institutional activity.
setup.transcript_quote: Daily VWAP resets every session and shows you intraday institutional activity.

setup.description: Context: weekly VWAP captures swing-trade positioning.
setup.transcript_quote: Weekly VWAP captures the bigger swing trade positioning.

setup.description: Context: monthly VWAP reveals the major trend and long-term anchoring.
setup.transcript_quote: Monthly VWAP reveals the major trend and where long-term players are anchored.

setup.description: Context: quarterly VWAP is also taught, tied to earnings season and fund positioning.
setup.transcript_quote: The quarterly VWAP strategy is pure gold during earning season. Institutions position their portfolios around quarterly performance. That makes quarterly VWAP the anchor point for major funds.

setup.description: Context: yearly VWAP is taught as a market-regime definer.
setup.transcript_quote: But here's what most traders never realize about yearly VWAP. This level defines entire market regimes. Bull market, price stays above yearly VWAP for months, even during corrections. Bear market, yearly VWAP becomes impenetrable resistance that caps every rally.

setup.description: Context: the bands drawn around VWAP are standard deviation bands representing statistical boundaries of normal price action.
setup.transcript_quote: These are standard deviation bands and they're showing you mathematical probability in real time, the statistical boundaries of normal price action.

setup.description: Context: the plus/minus one bands contain about 68% of price action and are described as the normal, unremarkable trading range.
setup.transcript_quote: The plus one and minus one bands contain about 68% of price action. This is the normal trading range. When price is between these bands, nothing special is happening.

setup.description: Context: the plus/minus two bands are stated as containing 95% of price action.
setup.transcript_quote: But watch what happens at the plus two and minus two bands. This is where 95% of price action should stay contained.

setup.description: Context: the plus/minus three bands are extreme levels reached by only 0.3% of price action, and reaching them means either genuine breakout or violent snap-back.
setup.transcript_quote: The plus three and minus three bands are the extreme levels. Only 0.3% of price action should reach here. When it does, you're either seeing a genuine breakout or an extreme overshoot that will snap back violently.

setup.description: Pre-market preparation step: identify all relevant VWAP levels per instrument.
setup.transcript_quote: First, identify all relevant VWAP levels. Daily, weekly, monthly for each instrument.

setup.description: Pre-market preparation step: note custom anchors from recent events.
setup.transcript_quote: Second, note any custom anchors from recent events.

setup.description: Pre-market preparation step: check the VWAP hierarchy for directional bias.
setup.transcript_quote: Third, check the VWAP hierarchy for directional bias.

setup.description: Watchlist selection criteria: instruments with multiple aligned VWAP timeframes, price near significant VWAP levels, and volume patterns suggesting institutional activity.
setup.transcript_quote: Look for instruments where multiple VWAP time frames are aligned. Price near significant VWAP levels. Volume patterns suggesting institutional activity.

setup.description: Anchor-selection rule for custom-anchored VWAP: the event must have moved the stock significantly.
setup.transcript_quote: First, the event must have moved the stock significantly.

setup.description: Anchor-selection rule for custom-anchored VWAP: the event must have generated massive volume.
setup.transcript_quote: Second, it must have generated massive volume.

setup.description: Anchor-selection rule for custom-anchored VWAP: the event should be fundamentally important to the company or market.
setup.transcript_quote: Third, it should be fundamentally important to the company or market.

setup.description: No-trade / stand-aside condition: in low-volume periods VWAP is less reliable and the taught response is to switch to alternative strategies or stay out.
setup.transcript_quote: Low volume periods make VWAP less reliable. Without institutional participation, VWAP levels become meaningless. This is when you switch to alternative strategies or simply stay out of the market.

setup.description: Reliability threshold: volume below 30% of average is stated to make VWAP lose meaning.
setup.transcript_quote: When volume drops below 30% of average, VWAP moves on so few shares that it loses meaning.

setup.description: Reference-point caution: a 3% overnight gap breaks session-VWAP continuity, with the stated real reference being yesterday's VWAP.
setup.transcript_quote: A 3% gap completely breaks VWAP continuity. The session VWAP starts in no man's land, while the real battle happens at yesterday's VWAP.

setup.description: Adverse-environment recognition: choppy price action plus wider bands signal a whipsaw environment.
setup.transcript_quote: The key is recognizing the choppy price action and wider bands that signal a whipsaw environment.

setup.description: Framing (non-executable): the educator states VWAP is a tool that must be adapted to market conditions, not a standalone strategy.
setup.transcript_quote: VWAP is a tool, not a strategy. You must adapt how you use it based on current market conditions.

setup.description: Framing (non-executable): stated motivation for a rules-based approach is that most VWAP trading is discretionary.
setup.transcript_quote: The problem with most VWAP trading is that it's too discretionary. Traders see price near VWAP and just wing it. No consistent rules, no systematic approach.

entry_sequence.action: Require three confirmations before taking any entry.
entry_sequence.rationale: The transcript states the entry model as a three-confirmation requirement.
entry_sequence.transcript_quote: For entries, you need three confirmations.

entry_sequence.action: Require a price action signal at VWAP.
entry_sequence.rationale: Stated as the first of the three required entry confirmations.
entry_sequence.transcript_quote: First, price action signal at VWAP.

entry_sequence.action: Require volume confirmation of institutional activity.
entry_sequence.rationale: Stated as the second of the three required entry confirmations.
entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Second, volume confirmation of institutional activity.

entry_sequence.action: Require directional bias from the higher time frame VWAP stack.
entry_sequence.rationale: Stated as the third of the three required entry confirmations.
entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Third, directional bias from higher time frame VWAP stack.

entry_sequence.action: Skip the trade unless all five playbook checklist items check out.
entry_sequence.rationale: The transcript states an explicit go/no-go gate on the five-item checklist.
entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Check all five or skip the trade.

confluences.name: Checklist item: price at VWAP
confluences.description: Playbook checklist question asked before a trade.
confluences.transcript_quote: Is price at VWAP?

confluences.name: Checklist item: volume above average
confluences.description: Playbook checklist question asked before a trade.
confluences.transcript_quote: Is volume above average?

confluences.name: Checklist item: multiple timeframes aligned
confluences.description: Playbook checklist question asked before a trade.
confluences.transcript_quote: Are multiple time frames aligned?

confluences.name: Checklist item: broader market supporting the direction
confluences.description: Playbook checklist question asked before a trade.
confluences.transcript_quote: Is the broader market supporting this direction?

confluences.name: Checklist item: bands expanding or contracting
confluences.description: Playbook checklist question asked before a trade.
confluences.transcript_quote: Are VWAP bands expanding or contracting?

confluences.name: Bullish multi-timeframe VWAP stack
confluences.description: Daily above weekly above monthly with price above all three is named institutional consensus.
confluences.transcript_quote: When all three VWAPs are stacked bullishly, daily above weekly above monthly, and price is above all three, you have what we call institutional consensus.

confluences.name: Bearish multi-timeframe VWAP stack
confluences.description: Monthly above weekly above daily with price below all three is stated as downside institutional alignment.
confluences.transcript_quote: When monthly is above weekly is above daily and price is below all three, institutional money is aligned to the downside.

confluences.name: Same-direction VWAP alignment
confluences.description: Daily, weekly and monthly VWAP all pointing the same direction is named institutional alignment.
confluences.transcript_quote: When daily, weekly, and monthly VWAP all point in the same direction, you have institutional alignment.

confluences.name: Timeframe hierarchy conflict resolution
confluences.description: On conflicting signals the longer timeframe governs.
confluences.transcript_quote: When daily says buy, but weekly says sell, weekly wins. When weekly says buy, but monthly says sell, monthly wins. The longer time frame always has more institutional commitment behind it.

confluences.name: Full-stack alignment including yearly
confluences.description: All timeframes including yearly broken the same direction is named institutional herding.
confluences.transcript_quote: When all time frames align, daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly VWAP all broken in the same direction, you're witnessing institutional herding.

confluences.name: Monthly VWAP directional filter
confluences.description: Position relative to monthly VWAP defines whether dips are bought or rips are shorted.
confluences.transcript_quote: When price is above monthly VWAP, every dip is a buying opportunity until proven otherwise. Below it, every rip is a shorting opportunity.

confluences.name: VWAP and high-volume-node confluence anchor
confluences.description: VWAP intersecting a high volume node from the volume profile is named a confluence anchor.
confluences.transcript_quote: When VWAP intersects with a high volume node from the volume profile, you get what institutions call a confluence anchor.

confluences.name: Flat VWAP slope
confluences.description: A flat slope is stated to indicate market balance.
confluences.transcript_quote: A flat VWAP means the market is in balance.

confluences.name: Steep VWAP slope
confluences.description: A steep slope is stated to indicate one side winning decisively, with strength proportional to the angle.
confluences.transcript_quote: A steep VWAP slope means one side is winning decisively. The steeper the angle, the stronger the institutional flow.

confluences.name: Long-wick rejection at the VWAP touch
confluences.description: Candle reading at the touch: a long wick rejection is stated to show institutional defense of the level.
confluences.transcript_quote: A long wick rejection shows institutional defense.

confluences.name: Weak doji at the VWAP touch
confluences.description: Candle reading at the touch: a weak doji is stated to show uncertainty.
confluences.transcript_quote: A weak doji shows uncertainty.

confluences.name: Strong close through VWAP with volume
confluences.description: Candle reading at the touch: a strong close through VWAP on volume is stated to be capitulation.
confluences.transcript_quote: But a strong close through VWAP with volume, that's capitulation.

confluences.name: High volume at VWAP
confluences.description: High volume at VWAP is stated to mean institutions are participating.
confluences.transcript_quote: High volume at VWAP means institutions are active.

confluences.name: Acceptance versus rejection time filter
confluences.description: More than three candles beyond VWAP is acceptance; an immediate snap back is rejection.
confluences.transcript_quote: If price breaks VWAP and stays below for more than three candles, it's accepted. If it immediately snaps back, it's rejected.

confluences.name: False break / liquidity grab pattern
confluences.description: A break of a few candles below VWAP that immediately reverses back above is framed as institutions grabbing liquidity before the real move higher.
confluences.transcript_quote: Price breaks below VWAP by a few candles, triggers all the stops, then immediately reverses back above. This isn't random. It's institutions grabbing liquidity before the real move higher.

confluences.name: Mean-reversion signal at the plus/minus two bands
confluences.description: Price reaching the two-deviation bands is stated to produce a mean reversion signal favoring a move back toward VWAP.
confluences.transcript_quote: When price hits these levels, you get mean reversion signals. The probability heavily favors a move back toward VWAP.

confluences.name: Band squeeze precedes expansion
confluences.description: Bands squeezing together indicate contracting volatility, with the tighter squeeze stated to precede a bigger expansion.
confluences.transcript_quote: When the bands squeeze together, volatility is contracting. This compression almost always leads to explosive moves. The tighter the squeeze, the bigger the eventual expansion.

stop.anchor: The next significant VWAP band or volume node
stop.rationale: Stop loss placement uses VWAP bands and volume profiles; the stop is placed at the next significant VWAP band or volume node, which the educator states ensures being stopped out only when institutional opinion changes.
stop.transcript_quote: Stop loss placement uses VWAP bands and volume profiles. Your stop goes at the next significant VWAP band or volume node. This ensures you're stopped out only when institutional opinion changes.

targets.type: next VWAP level or standard deviation band
targets.transcript_quote: Your first target is the next VWAP level or standard deviation band.
Your second target is the next volume node.

management.rule: Reassess the position when VWAP slope changes direction, volume dries up, or bands compress.
management.transcript_quote: When VWAP slope changes direction, volume dries up, or bands compress, institutional activity is shifting. Time to reassess your position.

management.rule: Size longer-timeframe trades by distance from monthly VWAP: half size at 5% extended, full size within 1%.
management.transcript_quote: For position sizing on longer time frame trades, the distance from VWAP determines everything. If you're 5% extended from monthly VWAP, use half size. If you're within 1%, use full size.

variants.name: Trending-market application
variants.rule: In trending markets VWAP is used as dynamic support or resistance rather than a reversion target.
variants.transcript_quote: In trending markets, VWAP becomes dynamic support or resistance.

variants.name: Trending-market application: pullback entry
variants.rule: In an uptrend, price pulls back to VWAP, finds support, and continues higher.
variants.transcript_quote: In an uptrend, price will pull back to VWAP, find support, and continue higher.

variants.name: Trending-market application: slope requirement
variants.rule: VWAP itself must be sloping in the direction of the trend.
variants.transcript_quote: The key is that VWAP itself is sloping in the direction of the trend.

variants.name: Ranging-market application
variants.rule: In ranging markets VWAP is treated as the center of gravity that price oscillates around.
variants.transcript_quote: But in ranging markets, VWAP becomes the center of gravity. Price oscillates around it like a pendulum.

variants.name: Ranging-market application: fade back to VWAP
variants.rule: Above VWAP look for shorts back to VWAP; below VWAP look for longs back to VWAP.
variants.transcript_quote: Above VWAP, look for shorts back to VWAP. Below VWAP, look for longs back to VWAP.

variants.name: Regime-matched strategy selection
variants.rule: Trend strategies are used in trending markets and mean reversion strategies in ranging markets.
variants.transcript_quote: Trend strategies in trending markets, mean reversion strategies in ranging markets.

variants.name: Mean-reversion mode selection at a band
variants.rule: If price immediately returns to VWAP after hitting a band, trade mean reversion.
variants.transcript_quote: If price immediately returns to VWAP after hitting a band, trade mean reversion.

variants.name: Trend-continuation mode selection at a band (band walk)
variants.rule: If price walks along the band instead of returning to VWAP, trade trend continuation.
variants.transcript_quote: If price walks along the band, trade trend continuation.

variants.name: Band walk in strong trends
variants.rule: In strong trends price rides along the plus one or minus one band and uses it as dynamic support or resistance instead of returning to VWAP.
variants.transcript_quote: In strong trends, price will ride along the plus one or minus one band. It doesn't return to VWAP. Instead, it uses the band as dynamic support or resistance.

variants.name: Volatile-market adaptation
variants.rule: In volatile markets the bands expand, normal mean reversion levels stop working, and wider bands and different probability thresholds are used.
variants.transcript_quote: Volatile markets create a different situation entirely. The VWAP bands expand dramatically. Normal mean reversion levels stop working. You need wider bands and different probability thresholds.

variants.name: Event-anchored VWAP
variants.rule: Anchor VWAP to major events such as earnings announcements, Fed meetings, and company keynotes.
variants.transcript_quote: VWAP anchored to major events, earnings announcements, Fed meetings, company keynotes.

variants.name: Alternative anchor: previous day high or low VWAP
variants.rule: Switch to the previous day's high or low VWAP when standard VWAP fails.
variants.transcript_quote: Switch to the previous day's high or low VWAP.

variants.name: Alternative anchor: weekly open VWAP
variants.rule: Use the weekly open VWAP when standard VWAP fails.

variants.name: Alternative anchor: last major volume spike
variants.rule: Anchor to the last major volume spike when standard VWAP fails.
variants.transcript_quote: Anchor to the last major volume spike.

variants.name: Post-news re-anchoring
variants.rule: After earnings, Fed announcements, or major economic data the pre-news VWAP is treated as irrelevant and new anchor points are required.
variants.transcript_quote: News events create the most interesting VWAP behavior. Earnings, Fed announcements, and major economic data can completely reset VWAP dynamics. The pre-news VWAP becomes irrelevant. You need new anchor points.

source_gaps.reason: The transcript never states a chart timeframe on which entries are executed. It counts candles (more than three candles) and names daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly VWAP anchors, but never fixes an execution chart interval.

The entry confirmation says higher time frame VWAP stack without fixing which one. Daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly VWAP are all taught, and the hierarchy rule only says the longer timeframe wins on conflict; it never states which pair or set is required for a given trade.

source_gaps.field: entry trigger specification (price action signal at VWAP)
source_gaps.reason: The required first confirmation is only named as a price action signal at VWAP. Three separate candle readings are taught (long wick rejection, weak doji, strong close through with volume) but the transcript never states which reading constitutes a valid long trigger versus a valid short trigger, nor whether the doji reading is tradable at all.

The entry requires volume confirmation of institutional activity and the checklist asks whether volume is above average, but no numeric entry threshold is given. The only number stated, below 30% of average, defines when VWAP loses meaning, not when an entry is confirmed.

The stop is defined only as the next significant VWAP band or volume node. The transcript does not state which standard deviation band counts as significant, does not resolve the choice between a band and a volume node when both are available, and gives no distance or risk amount.
No R multiple, risk percentage, account risk amount, or reward-to-risk requirement is stated anywhere for entries, stops, or targets.

First and second targets are named as levels but the transcript never states how much position is exited at each, whether the stop is moved after the first target, or how the trade is closed if neither target is reached.

source_gaps.field: position sizing between 1% and 5% extension from monthly VWAP
source_gaps.reason: Half size is stated at 5% extended and full size within 1%, but no rule is given for distances between 1% and 5% or beyond 5%, and the rule is scoped only to longer time frame trades without defining that scope.

Trending, ranging, volatile and whipsaw applications are each taught, and slope steepness is said to distinguish trending from ranging, but no measurable threshold or procedure is given for deciding which regime is active before a trade.

Mean reversion at the plus/minus two bands and trend continuation on a band walk are taught as mode selections, but the transcript states no entry price, stop, or exit price for either mode; only the direction of the expected move back toward VWAP.

source_gaps.field: which VWAP anchor the trade is executed against
source_gaps.reason: Session VWAP, event-anchored VWAP, previous day high/low VWAP, weekly open VWAP and last-volume-spike VWAP are all taught as usable anchors, but the transcript gives no rule for which anchor supplies the entry level on a given trade.
Beyond the statement that session VWAP resets at market open, no trading session, time window, or time-based exit is specified.

top_level_source_gaps.reason: No specific tradable instrument is prescribed. Apple and Tesla appear only as illustrative examples of institutional accumulation and of event anchoring; the routine otherwise refers generically to each instrument and to markets.

Only one section of the transcript supplies a complete executable set of entry, stop and target rules (the three-confirmation entry with VWAP-band/volume-node stop and VWAP/volume-node targets). All other taught material -- multi-timeframe stack alignment, slope reading, band probability zones, acceptance/rejection, event anchoring, and the trending/ranging/volatile adaptations -- supplies bias, level construction, or regime-specific application without its own stated stop and target, so it is recorded as setup, confluence, management or variant rather than as separate top-level strategies.

The transcript provides no historical performance data, win rate, sample size, or validation procedure for any of the taught rules; probability figures cited (68%, 95%, 0.3%) are descriptions of the standard deviation bands, not measured strategy results.
The video opens and closes with promotional framing (institutional-edge claims and an academy link) that is not executable trading instruction and has been excluded from the strategy containers.
